_help: Which of Shalone's drawings goes in which PICO-8 sprite slot. Each frame takes the next slot (2 frames fill N and N+1; a 16x16 drawing is 2 slots wide). Swap a name when she draws the real one, then: npm run pico8. Slots not listed are left alone, so things drawn in PICO-8's own editor stay.
_slots: 0 priest, 2 bishop, 4 deacon, 6 priest who works for the bishop, 16-25 people (5 bases, 2 frames each), 32 grace, 33 gift box, 34 rosary, 35 holy water bucket, 36 coffee, 37 car, 40-45 trees/flowers/rocks scattered on the grass (1 frame each), 48 house, 50 church, 52 hospital (16x16, 1 frame)
_parts: Colors in the people's base drawings that get swapped at random for each person: hair, skin, eyes, shirt, pants, shoes, clothes.
_colors: Force one of her colors onto a PICO-8 color number (0-15) when the nearest match is wrong or two parts land on the same one.
